title: REAL robot data: nyu_rot (xarm), 14 episodes from 1 RLDS shard(s)

rulebook.used_for: arm limits (Panda datasheet values), kinematic model, v_max

frames.note: state is quantized (median 2% distinct values per non-constant state channel over 440 frames); bit-identical consecutive rows are expected and are not evidence of a stale stream

action_state.note: ee-delta action interface: action-to-motion scale and frame are not declared; only a heuristic sign check ran

gripper.note: gripper command semantics not documented or channels missing

outcome.note: no independent outcome label to compare the reward with

semantic.note: no object state in dataset: object poses, object classes/dimensions, contact events and phase labels are not recorded, so type/size, support, contact, permanence, spatial, phase-grammar and task-success rules cannot be evaluated

source.selection: subset of shards chosen by file size to keep the total download < 300 MB; may be biased toward shorter episodes
source.why_not_huggingface: huggingface.co blocked by this environment's egress policy (HTTP 403 on CONNECT)

provenance.fps_source: not stored in the RLDS files and not used

profile.joint_units: no joint angles recorded (end-effector state only)

known_limitations: Real data, but only a small subset (shards selected by size to stay under 300 MB).

Semantic checks (object type/size, support, contact, permanence, spatial relations, phase grammar, task success) were NOT run: no object state in dataset: object poses, object classes/dimensions, contact events and phase labels are not recorded, so type/size, support, contact, permanence, spatial, phase-grammar and task-success rules cannot be evaluated
No per-frame timestamps in the source, so timing checks (monotonicity, gaps, jitter) were not run.
Heuristic findings (robust-range outliers, assumed command semantics) are advisory only and do not affect verdicts; they are listed in results/real_data.json.
Joint-limit and speed checks use external datasheet limits where stated (not the dataset's own metadata); if the arm model differs, those findings may be wrong.
No Z3 query is made in real-data mode; all checks are numeric.
Accepted means none of the runnable checks found a defect; it does not mean the data is correct. Not a safety certification. Demo signing key.

content.hash_method: sha256 over canonical JSON of sorted [episode_id, sha256(canonical episode JSON)]
